tools.name: video_storyboard
tools.description: Turn a video into ONE storyboard image you can actually look at: a numbered grid where each cell is a content segment, sampled at its sharpest moment, burned with its cell number. The reply lists every cell as 'cell 3 (r1c3) = 00:12.76-00:31.40 frame@00:20.84' plus that stretch's speech, so you can cite a moment instead of guessing. Cell count is chosen from duration and how fast the picture changes. Use this to answer questions about what is IN a video; it does not play audio. Pass from/to to read a slice of a long film, and cells/sheets only to override the automatic choice.

input.description: Absolute path to a video file readable by ffmpeg (mp4/mov/mkv/webm...). An http(s) link also works if yt-dlp is installed (Bilibili and most sites).

from.description: Window start in seconds. Default 0. Only this window is scanned and sampled.

to.description: Window end in seconds. Default: end of file.

cells.description: Cells per image, 1-16. Default: chosen automatically from duration and cut density. More cells = more coverage, but each one is smaller and on-screen text gets harder to read.

sheets.description: How many images to return, 1-4. Default: auto. Each extra image costs another image in the conversation.

detail.description: How many characters of speech per cell: low=60, med=120 (default), high=400. Truncation lands on a sentence boundary.

transcriptFile.description: Path to an existing transcript (SRT, or JSON with [{start,end,text}] / [{from,to,text}] / Bilibili {body:[{from,to,content}]}). When given, speech recognition and embedded subtitle tracks are both skipped — use this when the video already has captions.

summary.zh: 把一个视频压成一张可寻址的宫格图：每格带编号、对应精确时间、挂那一段的台词，底部是同时间轴的音频包络。
summary.en: Turn a video into one addressable storyboard grid: numbered cells, exact timestamps, per-cell speech and an audio envelope on the same timeline.

prompts.title: 环境说明（视频分镜）
prompts.content:
你可以「看」视频。这一节说明怎么用。

## 唯一工具

- `video_storyboard`：给它一个视频路径（或链接），它给你一张宫格图 + 一份文字索引。图会附加进本次对话，你自己看得到。

## 拿到回复后怎么读

回复分两段。开头是 `<storyboard ...>` 标签，里面写着时长、窗口、图片尺寸、格数、切点数量；接着是若干 `cell N (rXcY) = 起-止 frame@抽帧时刻` 加那一段的台词。

**`frame@` 不是格的起点。** 一格的画面取自它内部最清晰的那一帧，常常偏向格的末尾。看到某格是标题板，不等于标题板出现在格的起点。

**格内出现 `[m:ss.s]` 标记，说明那里换了个话题。** 不要拿格的起点当新话题的起点。

**`cuts` 是这个格内剪了几刀。** 数字大说明这段是快切蒙太奇；如果清单里出现 `cut count unreliable`，就不要拿 `cuts=N` 当节奏依据。

## 什么时候该用

有人问「这个视频里有什么」「第几分钟在干什么」「这段画面是什么样」，而你手上没有画面时。

## 什么时候不该用

- 只是想聊视频的剧情、口碑、评价 —— 那用不上看画面。
- 视频很长而你只关心一句话 —— 先用 `from`/`to` 缩小窗口，不要一次性读两小时。

## 代价

一次调用会花掉一张图的额度，并需要几秒到几十秒（取决于时长）。所以：短片段一次就够；长片按窗口切着读，别重复看同一段。

## 局限

- 只听不到声音：音频只以包络形式画在底部条带里，不转成可听内容。台词来自字幕轨或本机识别，**没有配置识别后端时台词是空的**。
- 一格是一段时间，不是一个瞬间；格内的细节可能被压缩掉。
- 识别出的台词可能有错字，引用人名、术语前先和画面上的文字对一下。
